_comment: Baseline-managed fragment merged into a target repo's .claude/settings.json by install.sh. Hook commands all point under .claude/hooks/baseline/ so they never collide with a repo's own hooks, and the merge is idempotent (it replaces any existing entry whose command references /.claude/hooks/baseline/). permissions.deny is unioned with whatever the repo already denies; the repo's allow list is left untouched. The deny-list SELF-PROTECTS the baseline: it refuses agent Edit() to .claude/baseline.config.json, .claude/settings.json, and .claude/hooks/baseline/** so the posture and hooks that govern every control can't be silently downgraded in-session by a prompt-injected or careless agent. The deny-list only governs the AGENT's tools; the opt-in ConfigChange config-guard hook below additionally detects HUMAN/external edits to .claude/settings.json that strip the baseline wiring/deny-list or set disableAllHooks. If you change the deny entries here, update EXPECTED_DENY in modules/config-guard.sh too (tests/policy-change-gate.sh enforces a fixture update).
